issues.reason: expect is listed as a NON-FACTIVE attitude verb, so top-level MeasureAtLeast/MeasureAtMost atoms make the forecast a fact of the KB exactly as a flat (Member sk_bridge_1 unsafe) would wrongly make the bridge unsafe — over-assertion, and since the entity-object route explicitly bars sealing there is no licensed carrier, so the offending atoms are removed.

The half that stands: (Time sk_expect_1 fourth_quarter) is false — the expecting is not claimed to happen in Q4 — so the head must go; the half that is overstated: a fronted sentential PP may modify the matrix predication, and the preposition-named oblique (the head being the preposition actually used) records it faithfully as (For sk_expect_1 fourth_quarter) without having to relocate it onto the revenue.

(Measure <entity> <scale> ...) puts the bearer in the entity slot and the dimension noun in the scale slot ("costs $20" -> price on the thing priced), so a revenue witness measured on scale revenue is a shape the rule does not license; the repair removes both measure atoms with issue 0, which resolves it.

gaps_confirmed: an intensional / forecast NP object of a non-factive attitude verb — the entity-object route assumes an independently existing referent and sealing is barred for entity objects, so a predicted quantity has no encoding at all
scale words in a monetary magnitude ("$8.1 billion") — no rule for million/billion, so billion_dollar is a coined unit no canonical conversion reaches
a two-sided range ("between X and Y") has no stated form; pairing MeasureAtLeast with MeasureAtMost is a plausible composition but is nowhere licensed
new_gaps: a fronted fiscal-period frame PP ("For the fourth quarter, ...") — nothing says whether a period-of-applicability attaches to the matrix event or to the measured noun, and no role covers a period that is not the event's own time
repair_summary: Removed the two top-level measure atoms, which asserted the forecast range as fact under a non-factive attitude verb; replaced the false (Time sk_expect_1 fourth_quarter) with the preposition-named oblique (For sk_expect_1 fourth_quarter).
notes: The range was dropped rather than sealed because the instruction set routes an attitude verb's entity object to Experiencer/Stimulus with "no sealing", so any seal here would be an unlicensed encoding; the loss is the registered gap, not a licence to invent. Experiencer/Stimulus, the untensed present, and fourth_quarter as a bare named-time constant are all correct and untouched.
